string.value: (Elliza must be in a deep sleep.)

string.value: You need a place to store your items and mesos? Then you came to the right place.

string.name: n0
string.value: I made these scrolls, so I can guarantee that these all work to perfection!

string.value: I've been in here for 30 years now...

string.name: d0
string.value: It's been a while since I last saw a person here, in this place far far away from humanity. I've been in need of help, and I'm glad to see you here.

string.name: d1
string.value: You're the one who helped me gather those monster samples. Thanks to you my research has picked up steam, but honestly, I can use some more samples. If you see me by the time I run out of these samples, who knows, I may ask you for more.
